description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'EmailConfigurationServiceTest' that tests the functionality of the EmailConfigurationService class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes test methods for retrieving DAO, email service, and sending test emails, utilizing mock objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes an instance of EmailConfigurationService before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmailConfigurationDao
methods.description: Tests that the EmailConfigurationService correctly returns an instance of EmailConfigurationDao.

methods.name: xtestGetEmailService
methods.description: Test method meant to verify getEmailService, currently disabled (prefixed with 'x').

methods.name: testSendTestMail
methods.description: Tests the sendTestMail method, simulating sending an email and asserting the outcome.
